analysis:
Examined all supplied units, including file metadata. AppAttestKeyHistoryBuilder.swift:50 replaces Date <= with timeIntervalSince(now) <= 0 while preserving the generation-window upper bound, count cap and last-generation-age calculation. For ordinary Date values this retains inclusion of past/equal timestamps and exclusion of future timestamps; no new authorization, evidence disclosure or generation-budget bypass is established. The documented purpose is avoiding unavailable weak-imported operators and improving A-018 availability.
Reviewed docs/threat-model.yaml:1390–2504 against the canonical index and selected T-041 detail. These excerpts are unchanged according to the complete range map: cache scope/encryption/TTL and external-volume limitations, attestation replay and legacy trust reuse, rollback, fan authority, media confidentiality, App Attest authorization/revocation, reward qualification, diagnostics, local holds and sandbox execution retain their stated boundaries and accepted risks (T-041, T-033–T-037, T-042–T-048, T-050, T-052–T-061). The only documentation addition, at lines 41–48 in the supplied patch context, describes the compatibility fix without claiming stronger trust or revalidating historical controls.
No supported security regression was identified in this local scope. Integration should reconcile the related generation-budget, enrollment-resume and stall-restart substitutions with this history predicate, and verify the claimed release weak-import check in scripts/check-provider-weak-imports.py. Those implementations and unchanged callers were not supplied here; documentation alone does not verify their behavior.
